$meta.name: Sous Design Tokens
$meta.status: ACTIVE — colors signed off 2026-09-20; type and icon scales consolidated 2026-09-20. Decision log: design/TOKEN-DECISIONS.md
$meta.description: Single source of truth for Sous visual design. Every color, type role, and spacing value in the app resolves to a token here. Semantic tokens carry a light and a dark value; primitives never do.

conventions.primitive: Raw palette values. Named by hue + numeric step (higher = darker, except the blush ramp). Never referenced directly by a view.
conventions.semantic: Role-named tokens views actually use. Each has light and dark values pointing at primitives.
conventions.$status: 'shipped' = value verified present in the current build and enforced by design/check-tokens.py. 'advisory' = the intended scale, applied opportunistically rather than enforced. See TOKEN-DECISIONS.md.
conventions.$swift: The symbol in SousTheme.swift that owns this token. Tokens without one are aliases that resolve to another token's symbol. design/check-tokens.py verifies every $swift token's light/dark hex against SousTheme.swift.

100.$description: Warm off-white. Primary light background / dark-mode text.

900.$description: Near-black. Primary light text and strong borders / dark background.

500.$description: Muted text: captions, timestamps, done steps, placeholders.

50.$description: Pale wash. Light-mode highlighted rows, user chat bubbles.

400.$description: Lifted burgundy for legibility on dark surfaces.

700.$description: Brand burgundy. CTAs, accents, section headers, nav bar.

950.$description: Near-black with burgundy tint. Dark-mode highlighted rows.

700.$description: Muted success green. Patch-diff additions only.

100.$description: Voice mode: listening waveform, bright state label.

300.$description: Voice mode: speaking waveform, speaking label, exit icon.

500.$description: Voice mode: ready/thinking labels, secondary voice text.

surface.$description: Chat sheet, history drawer, input fields.

surfaceInverse.$description: Ink-filled controls that stay dark in both modes (history drawer settings button, ACCEPT CHANGES fill).

highlight.$description: Timer-highlight rows, user chat bubbles, tag backgrounds.

scrim.$description: Photo acquisition backdrop behind the chat sheet.

muted.$description: Captions, timestamps, struck-through done steps, placeholders.

accent.$description: Section headers, active states, REJECT label.
accent.$alias: Alias of accent.primary — same symbol, different role.

onAccent.$description: Text and icons sitting on a burgundy fill.
onAccent.$alias: Alias of primitive cream; no dedicated symbol.

onInverse.$description: Text and icons sitting on an ink fill.
onInverse.$alias: Alias of primitive white; no dedicated symbol.

primary.$description: CTA fill, nav bar, checked checkbox fill, voice bar background.

strong.$alias: Alias of text.primary — borders and text share one ink symbol.

added.$description: Patch-diff additions. The only non-burgundy accent in the app.

voice.$description: Voice mode renders on a burgundy fill in both modes, so these do not invert.

labelSpeaking.$description: 'speaking' label, speaking waveform, exit icon, patch-pending text.

exitBorder.$description: Voice exit button border, white at 20%.
exitBorder.$alias: Applied inline as white at 20% opacity; no dedicated symbol.

typography.$description: Every text style in the app. Views reference these by name — inline font sizes are rejected by design/check-tokens.py. Monospace appears in exactly two roles: numeric readouts and voice bar state labels.

sousLogotype.$description: SOUS wordmark on the blank state.

sousBody.$description: Ingredient rows, step text, chat messages.

sousButtonQuiet.$description: De-emphasised button labels — destructive or secondary actions.

sousHeading1.$description: Markdown H1 in assistant chat messages.

sousHeading2.$description: Markdown H2 in assistant chat messages.

sousHeading3.$description: Markdown H3 and below in assistant chat messages.

sousReadoutLarge.$description: Timer-done banner — the largest readout in the app.

sousReadout.$description: Active countdown in the adjust-timer sheet.

sousPickerValue.$description: Digits in the duration and servings wheels.

sousVoiceLabel.$description: Voice bar state labels — ready, listening, speaking, thinking.

serif.$description: SwiftUI design: .serif. Identity font — titles and wordmark only.

mono.$description: SwiftUI design: .monospaced. Permitted in exactly two roles — numeric readouts (timers, durations, servings) and voice bar state labels — because equal-width digits stop countdowns jittering. Banned everywhere else. See decision 8.

hairline.$description: The only border width in the app. 36 uses, zero exceptions.

none.$description: Sous uses no shadows or elevation. Structure comes from borders.

spacing.$description: An 8-step scale covering ~90% of current usage. Deliberately NOT enforced: 20 distinct padding values remain in the app and no sweep is planned, because changing padding moves layout rather than just glyph size. The rule is opportunistic — when you touch a view's spacing for any other reason, snap the values you touch to the nearest step below. Decided 2026-09-20; see TOKEN-DECISIONS.md decision 13.

gutter.$description: Left/right content margin. The app's dominant rhythm — 52 uses.

iconSize.$description: The five permitted SF Symbol sizes, expressed in code as the SousIconSize enum and applied with Font.sousIcon(_:weight:). Consolidated from eleven ad-hoc sizes in September 2026; 13 of 35 sites moved, none by more than 2pt.

small.$description: Chevrons, close buttons, inline row affordances. 17 sites.

medium.$description: Standard bar and control icons — send, scan, pencil. 10 sites.

large.$description: Prominent controls — drawer buttons, mic, camera. 6 sites.

xLarge.$description: Feature icons in sheets and pickers. 3 sites.
